context_visible: Aerial view of a river separating large agricultural fields on the left from a residential area on the right.
The fields contain organized rows of green crops and several long, white plastic greenhouses.
The residential area features multi-story brick apartment buildings and a street with parked vehicles.
The riverbank is lined with dry, brown vegetation and scattered debris.
cross_view_relations: The crop view zooms in on the riverbank area visible in the context image.
The crop view shows the transition from the river's edge to the residential buildings, confirming the spatial layout seen in the wide shot.
The crop view reveals that the area between the river and the buildings is densely packed with small garden plots and temporary structures.
perception.description: Aerial imagery shows a river dividing agricultural land with greenhouses from a residential district. The zoomed view details the riverbank, revealing dense, small-scale vegetable plots and scattered debris situated directly between the water and the base of the apartment buildings.
evidence_visible: Close-up of the riverbank showing numerous small, rectangular garden plots with varying green vegetation.
Visible debris, including white tarps, blue containers, and miscellaneous materials, scattered among the plots.
The base of the red brick apartment buildings is visible, with a paved road and parked cars (white and black) separating the buildings from the garden area.
The ground appears uneven and cluttered with non-agricultural items.
unclear: Specific types of crops or plants in the small plots.
Exact nature of the debris (e.g., construction waste vs. household trash).
Ownership or legal status of the garden plots.
Identity of the vehicles or people.
